Package com.csse3200.game.bestiary

Class BestiaryService

java.lang.Object
com.csse3200.game.bestiary.BestiaryService
public class BestiaryService extends Object
Owns Bestiary definitions, player discovery progress, and UI-safe queries.

    • replaceProgress

      public void replaceProgress(Map<String,BestiaryUnlockState> restoredProgress)
      Atomically replaces discovery progress using stable enemy IDs.

      Entries omitted from the supplied map become locked. Unknown but well-formed enemy IDs are ignored so saves remain loadable when the configured roster changes between versions.

      Parameters:
      restoredProgress - progress loaded from a validated save
